title: IATF ka Ɛntɛrinɛti yɔrɔ
summary: International Accessibility Task Force ka yɔrɔ forobaciyɛn.
problem: IATF mago tun bɛ forobaciyɛn lakanani la min bɛ misali ɲɛfɔ, ka baaraw sɛbɛn, ani ka dɛmɛ donbaaw bila sira ɲuman kan ka taa ɲɛ.
why: O yɔrɔ in ye IATF ka forobaciyɛnba ye. A jɔra i n'a fɔ porojɛkiti fitinin, o la a ka nɔgɔn ka kalan, ka bayɛlɛma, ani k'a mara kɛnɛ kan.
scopeIn: Jamanadenw ka baraw munnu bɛ IATF modɛli ɲɛfɔ
IATF ka porojɛkitiw lakodɔnnenw, minnu bɛ baara la, ani minnu maralen don, ni u cogoya, u marabaga, u marayɔrɔ ani u jirali ye
Bamanankan bɔyɔrɔ n'a jɔcogo labɛnnen don bayɛlɛmani kama
Static deployment on Cloudflare Workers Static Assets
scopeOut: Sigiyɔrɔ jɛkuluw, jatew, walima donni siraw
Baarakɛyɔrɔ min bɛ forobaciyɛnw ka kodɔn mara, min bɛ sɔrɔ baara kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka sɛbɛnmarayɔrɔ la
Kumaɲɔgɔnya waati yɛrɛ la, min bɛ kɛ ni Discord ye
Gɛlɛya tuguli baara kelen-kelenw kama, min sigilen don baara kelen kelen bɛɛ ka GitHub marayɔrɔ la

title: IATF ka selfie
summary: IATF ka prototip fɔlɔ dɔ, min maralen kɔ ka sɔrɔ ka se a jɔyɔrɔ la.
problem: Sɛgɛsɛgɛri daminɛni ka ɲɛsin fɛɛrɛ dɔ ma min ɲɛsinnen don nɔgɔya ma IATF ka fanga kɔrɔ.
why: A bɛ to ka mara i n'a fɔ baara sɛbɛn, hali ni a ka yiriwali jɔra.
scopeIn: Baara min ɲɛsinnen bɛ sɔrɔli ma n'a bɛ mara forobaciyɛnw kɔnɔ
scopeOut: Ka baara kɛ ka ɲɛsin yiriwali ma walima ka baara kɛ ni fɛn ye
Ka baara kɛ ni minɛn min ye

title: IATF bot
summary: IATF sigida bot, archived after reaching a natural stopping point.
problem: Automation around IATF community channels (IATF sigida taabolow sira fɛ).
why: A bɛ to ka mara i n'a fɔ baara sɛbɛn, hali ni a ka yiriwali jɔra.
scopeIn: Discord automation around IATF community channels, kept as a public record, min bɛ mara i n'a fɔ jama ka sɛbɛn
scopeOut: Ka baara kɛ ka ɲɛsin yiriwali ma walima ka baara kɛ ni fɛn ye
Ka baara kɛ ni minɛn min ye
